embedding_reproducibility_diagnostic.plausible_major_source: RDKit ETKDGv3 embedding is not reproducible across separate process invocations despite an explicit fixed randomSeed=42 (decisionbench_dd_docking/prepare_ligands.py) -- verified directly for GM_009 (blinded PMD_0133): identical canonical/protonated SMILES and atom count between the frozen primary docking_input_ligands/GM_009_3KEH.sdf and this run's freshly-prepared SDF, but starting-conformer heavy-atom coordinates differ by up to 1.6953 A (mean 0.2744 A). This is a substantially larger effect than the previously-documented ~0.0009 cross-machine CNNaffinity drift (Appendix H), which characterized only Ambroxol's own score, not the full candidate population. This is not a controlled experiment isolating embedding as the sole varying input: which physical machine ran which docking batch was not recorded, so an additional contribution from other run-level or hardware factors cannot be ruled out on top of the embedding effect.
embedding_reproducibility_diagnostic.bootstrap_interval_caveat: The matched cluster-bootstrap interval below conditions on one embedding-and-docking realization per molecule and therefore does not capture within-molecule procedural variability from repeated ligand embedding.

posthoc_amended_samebatch_analysis.note: Post-hoc amended same-batch analysis: candidates and decoys docked in the same blinded batch, emphasized as the less-confounded DESCRIPTIVE estimate (not a confirmatory primary analysis -- this emphasis was adopted after inspecting results; see decoy_addendum_v1.0.md's amendment log).
posthoc_amended_samebatch_analysis.bootstrap_interval_caveat: The matched cluster-bootstrap interval below conditions on one embedding-and-docking realization per molecule and therefore does not capture within-molecule procedural variability from repeated ligand embedding.
posthoc_amended_samebatch_analysis.interpretation: Decoy rate below candidate rate but >10%, or RR CI includes 1: possible but weak discrimination; gate remains poorly calibrated.

preregistered_crossrun_analysis_confound.note: Preregistered cross-run analysis, subsequently identified as confounded: as originally pre-registered in decoy_addendum_v1.0.md, decoy rate vs. the FROZEN primary 16/69. Retained, not withdrawn -- known to be confounded by cross-run embedding variance (see embedding_reproducibility_diagnostic).
preregistered_crossrun_analysis_confound.interpretation: Decoy rate >= candidate rate: no evidence the structural proxy enriches pipeline candidates over matched unrelated molecules.

gate_mechanism_interpretation: The gates are conjunctive, so this table decomposes them marginally (each column scored independently against the full population, not cumulatively): reordering them cannot change the final pass set, only which gate receives marginal attribution. Both catalytic-site contact (92.8% vs. 69.0%) and the CNNaffinity-vs-Ambroxol threshold (36.2% vs. 24.6%) show a descriptive population difference; CNNaffinity is the more restrictive filter in absolute terms for both populations, but contact is not merely incidental -- it is not the only gate component that differs between populations.
caveat: Decoys are not experimentally confirmed GCase inactives; this estimates background acceptance/discrimination, not biological specificity or target-specific binding. Without measured affinities, the CNNaffinity-HAC association below cannot distinguish model bias from a genuine physical size-affinity relationship.
